entries.title: I Corinthians 13:1
segments: Though I speak in the 'tongues' of men, or even of angels, yet have not Love, I have become mere echoing brass, or a clanging cymbal!

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:2
segments: Even though I have the gift of preaching, and fathom all hidden truths and all the depths of knowledge; even though I have such faith as might move mountains, yet have not Love, I am nothing!

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:3
segments: Even though I dole my substance to the poor, even though I sacrifice my body, that I may boast, yet have not Love, it avails me nothing!

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:4
segments: Love is long-suffering, and kind; Love is never envious, never boastful, never conceited, never behaves unbecomingly;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:5
segments: Love is never self-seeking, never provoked, never reckons up her wrongs;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:6
segments: Love never rejoices at evil, but rejoices in the triumph of Truth;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:7
segments: Love bears with all things, every trustful, ever hopeful, ever patient.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:8
segments: Love never fails. But, whether it be the gift of preaching, it will be done with; whether it be the gift of 'tongues,' it will cease; whether it be knowledge, it, too, will be done with.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:9
segments: For our knowledge is incomplete, and our preaching is incomplete,

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:10
segments: But, when the Perfect has come, that which is incomplete will be done with.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:11
segments: When I was a child, I talked as a child, I felt as a child, I reasoned as a child; now that I am a man, I have done with childish ways.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:12
segments: As yet we see, in a mirror, dimly, but then-face to face! As yet my knowledge is incomplete, but then I shall know in full, as I have been fully known.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:13
segments: Meanwhile Faith, Hope, and Love endure-these three, but the greatest of these is Love.
